description.value:
Requirement You are wielding a loaded firearm and the target has cover from an object rather than a creature.

Cover is a guess about what a bullet will not go through, and it is frequently wrong.

Make a ranged Strike that treats the intervening object as though it were not there, ignoring the cover bonus entirely. Reduce the damage by one die if the object is masonry, plate, or thicker than a hand's width; the GM may rule truly impassable barriers out of reach of this feat.

cinderfall.incomplete: +. This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP. "Ignore/downgrade cover" clauses have no confirmed rule element: the full rule-element/ directory listing contains nothing named for cover. This is flagged rather than asserted as a confirmed absence, since the actual cover-to-AC/Reflex calculation code path itself wasn't traced independently.
